text:
Ellen (Partnerships): Heads-up: new partner wants to list multiple builds + an SI-fork in our marketplace and bundle with HW. Need to lock down licensing + reseller rules before we onboard.
Tom (Marketplace): What are the exact asks from partner? Are they allowing us to host the artifacts or only link to upstream?
Ellen (Partnerships): They want Redwood to host two builds (vanilla and quant) and also let SI publish an optimized fork. They also want co-marketing and a simultaneous marketplace + press launch.
Ravi (Legal): Key legal points: (1) explicit consent_rehost flag in contract, (2) whether sublicensing to resellers is allowed, (3) attribution and license preservation, (4) export controls. We should require SPDX identifier and a manifest with sha256.
Diego (HW): For HW bundles we need perf_profile and hw_revision in metadata. If SI fork changes perf numbers, we must publish separate SKUs.
Sofia (SI): SI will add kernel-level optimizations. We need a clear modification_level: NONE | OPTIMIZE_ONLY | FULL_FORK. Revenue split and pricing should be configurable per SKU.
Tom (Marketplace): SKU policy proposal: `vendor.model.build.mod.region.bundle` e.g., `nova-aurora-13b-q4-opt-us-west-hwpack`. That gives uniqueness for billing and inventory.
Ravi (Legal): Also add `allowed_resell` boolean and `indemnity_required` if allowed_resell == true. If partner forbids sublicensing, we should only list as "link-only" and not host artifacts.
AutoBot: Policy reminder: manifests must include `spdx_id`, `sha256`, `export_classification`. Systems will auto-block regions when export_classification != "unrestricted".
Ellen (Partnerships): Good. UX ask: show a small provenance pill: "Upstream / SI fork / Vendor fork" with a hover linking to manifest. Also show "resell allowed" or "link-only" badge.
Diego (HW): Hardware marketing wants 10 business days embargo for images/spec validation before public listing. Can we align marketplace listing window with that?
Tom (Marketplace): We can support co_marketing_window_days. If >0 we hold the public listing until that date and show a private preview to partners.
Sofia (SI): On optimization boundaries: quantization and kernel-level tuning are OPTIMIZE_ONLY. Architecture changes require FULL_FORK opt-in from vendor. Need that explicit in onboarding.
Ravi (Legal): Action: I'll draft a short redistribution clause and modification_level definitions and add `consent_rehost` + `allowed_resell` to the contract template.
Ellen (Partnerships): Ops note: we need manifest signature verification with partner cert and webhook on validation failure to #partnerships.
AutoBot: Deploy rule added: manifest.validation.failed -> notify #partnerships with {sha256, reason, partner}.
Tom (Marketplace): Dev tasks: add provenance pill, resell badge, SKU parser tweaks. Can prototype UI by next Thu.
Diego (HW): I'll provide sample perf_profile CSVs and hw_rev tags by Tue.
Sofia (SI): I'll supply two sample SI-fork manifests for testing.
Ravi (Legal): Timeline: draft clause by Wed COB; contract update + onboarding checkbox `consent_rehost` by Fri.
Ellen (Partnerships): Great — I'll open a partnership-ticket and attach the sample manifests when ready. Thanks all. :rocket:
